verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover AI insights from user-supplied sources in depth. These include grounded chat with inline citations, auto-generated source summaries, mind maps, briefings and study guides, and AI-suggested report types. Community users independently confirm it is useful for research and for high-level walkthroughs of their material. Missing for 10: hands-on probe verification of insight/suggestion quality (the probes only confirm help pages are fetchable), and community reports that the audio-overview format has limits (e.g. can't pronounce math, clunky interaction).
